doc-engine is a high-performance headless document layout and vector rendering engine designed for React and TypeScript. It solves the issue of bloated, server-heavy PDF generation by calculating layout coordinates in pure TypeScript and emitting native vector PDF 1.7 operators and 60 FPS HTML5 Canvas previews locally.

Key stack: TypeScript, React 19, HTML5 Canvas, and native PDF 1.7 spec implementation. It features automatic pagination, real-time rendering, and avoids heavy dependencies like Puppeteer or Python daemons. It is published as an npm package (@worklabs05/doc-engine).

GitHub: https://github.com/junaidmirr/doc-engine.git
Demo: https://docengine.worklabs.studio

messages.content: Hello! I am Junaid's portfolio assistant. You can ask me about his software projects like doc-engine or CoolPath, his engineering skills, or how to get in touch with him. How can I help you today?

Junaid specializes in full-stack development with a strong focus on high-performance systems and developer tooling. His core skills include React, TypeScript, and Rust, with extensive experience in building low-latency vector rendering engines, static analysis tools, and AI-integrated applications. He is proficient in developing complex CLI tools for the Tauri ecosystem and implementing real-time communication systems. His expertise spans AST-based code navigation, thermodynamic modeling, and optimizing web-based rendering workflows to replace traditional headless browser dependencies.

I am Junaid's portfolio assistant and can only answer questions about Junaid, his engineering projects (such as doc-engine or CoolPath), technical skills, and background. Feel free to ask about any of his projects!

Junaid has built several notable engineering projects:

Layer: An open-source tool for AST code navigation, static call-graph analysis, and an MCP server for AI agents.

doc-engine: A high-performance, headless vector PDF rendering engine for React and TypeScript that supports 60 FPS Canvas previews.

Tauri Core CLI: An upstream contribution to the Tauri framework that enables automated, non-interactive CLI initialization for CI/CD environments.

CoolPath: An AI-driven microclimate navigation engine that uses thermal rasters and thermodynamic modeling to find shade-rich routes.

Edugate: An Android-based virtual classroom application featuring real-time video conferencing, screen sharing, and resource management.

You can view these on his GitHub at github.com/junaidmirr.
